lede: Baylor carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.7 against -6.0, a 7.7-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Baylor -13.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Baylor winning 82% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is offensive line, where Baylor leads Colorado by 80 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 88% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
